title: anil nudicaulis

It has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Anil nudicaulis include iridoid glycosides and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
